summary: Re-tested the TORUS bootstrap.sh fixes in a simulated Termux layout (temp HOME/PREFIX, TORUS_REPO=file:///app, branch main @ a2a8ca0). Results: iter11 regression suite 14/14 PASS; new suite test_torus_bootstrap_iter12.py 9/9 PASS. (1) After bootstrap the checkout is clean, core.fileMode=false is set, `git pull --ff-only` works, and the phase scripts are executable (100755 in git). A re-run picks up a new upstream commit. (2) Piped `cat bootstrap.sh | bash` under setsid (no controlling tty) with a stdin-reading stand-in torus: the children got /dev/null (got: was empty, not script lines), the Claude block ends the output, exit 0. (3) A non-git ~/.torus/src is moved to backups/src-not-git-*/ and the clone goes ahead. An edited INSTALL.md is listed and copied to backups/src-edits-*/torus/INSTALL.md, then reset to the committed content. A deleted tracked file is restored. (4) `torus help`: the ask --model line includes haiku, and there is a single `llm model` line. `torus status` exits 0 with no service dirs. (5) 'Phases 0-9' is in bootstrap.sh, but README.md line 20 uses an en dash ('Phases 0–9'), so the literal grep from the request does not find it there. GitHub raw URL: 404 (recorded, expected until the user saves to GitHub). Edge issues found: switching TORUS_BRANCH between runs fails (exit 128); paths with spaces in porcelain are split by awk; untracked files are backed up again on every run; `torus restart all` exits 1 when the last service dir is missing.

minor.issue: Switching branch between runs fails. The clone is `--depth 1 -b BRANCH`, which is single-branch. A later run with another TORUS_BRANCH does `fetch origin other`, which only writes FETCH_HEAD; then `reset --hard origin/other` fails with 'ambiguous argument origin/other' and exit 128 (reproduced). Fix: `git fetch --depth 1 origin "+refs/heads/$BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"`, or `reset --hard FETCH_HEAD`.

`git status --porcelain | awk '{print $2}'` with `for f in $dirty` breaks on paths that contain spaces. Porcelain quotes them, so the list shows `"torus/my` and `notes.txt"` and cp silently copies nothing. It also only keeps the old name of a staged rename. No tracked file has a space today, so the risk is low. Use `git status --porcelain -z`, or `git diff --name-only -z` plus `git ls-files -mo --exclude-standard -z`, with a while-read loop.

Untracked files (??) count as edits. They are copied to a new src-edits-<time> dir on every run, because reset --hard does not remove them, so backups pile up. Use `--untracked-files=no` for the backup decision, or say that untracked files are left in place.

Same pattern as the old status bug: `for s ...; do [ -d "$SVDIR/$s" ] && sv restart "$s"; done` exits 1 when the last service dir is missing (reproduced: restart=1). Add `; true` as was done for status.

The text reads 'Phases 0–9' with an en dash (U+2013). The meaning is right, but `grep 'Phases 0-9' README.md` finds nothing, as the request expected it to. Use an ASCII hyphen if literal grep matters.

action_items: bootstrap.sh:45-46: make the update path work when the branch changes. Use fetch with an explicit refspec `+refs/heads/$BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH`, or `git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD`.
bootstrap.sh:39-43: build the dirty-file list with NUL separators (porcelain -z) so paths with spaces are kept. Also leave untracked files out of the backup trigger, or back them up only once.
torus/bin/torus:324: add `; true` after the `restart all` loop, as was done for status.
Optional: README.md:20 'Phases 0–9' (en dash) -> 'Phases 0-9' (ASCII), so text searches match.
GitHub: the raw bootstrap URL still returns 404. The user must use Emergent Save to GitHub on branch main.
critical_code_review_comments: main() wrapper plus IN=/dev/tty or /dev/null works: verified under setsid with no ctty. The stdin-reading children got an empty line, not the script.

The review request said to put the stand-in torus in $PREFIX/bin. bootstrap re-links $PREFIX/bin/torus with `ln -sfn` to the real CLI, so a stand-in there would be replaced and the real `torus install all` would run. The test puts the stand-in in a stub dir at the front of PATH instead.
cmd_update (`pull --ff-only` with core.fileMode=false) works on the depth-1 clone when upstream is ahead.

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 requested checks pass; 5 minor edge issues found outside the requested scope)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app && /tmp/tv/bin/python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_torus_bootstrap_iter11.py backend/tests/test_torus_bootstrap_iter12.py -p no:cacheprovider -n 0. The iter12 piped test uses `setsid -w` so there is no ctty. Do not put a stand-in torus in $PREFIX/bin, because bootstrap overwrites it with a symlink to the real CLI. Never run the real `torus install all` outside Termux.
rca_of_issue: Branch switch: `git clone --depth 1 -b X` sets remote.origin.fetch to refs/heads/X only. A plain `git fetch origin Y` therefore never creates refs/remotes/origin/Y, and `reset --hard origin/Y` fails. Repro: clone origin, create branch other, run bootstrap with TORUS_BRANCH=main, then again with TORUS_BRANCH=other -> exit 128.
